senses.gloss:
m. (-चः)
A sort of bread-fruit tree, (Artocarpus lacucha.)
E.
लकुच q. v. and इ substituted for the first vowel.

m. (-क्षा)
A nit, a young louse.
E.
a various reading of लिक्षा.

f. (-क्षा)
1 A nit, a young louse, or the egg of a louse.
2 A poppy seed, considered as a measure of weight, or 1/6th of a mustard seed.
E.
लक्ष to mark, aff. घञ्, इ substituted for the radical vowel and the deriv. irr.; also क्क being substituted for the final लिक्का, and with कन् added, fem. form, लिक्षिका again with ई substituted for the radical vowel लीक्षा, &c.
